tree: Send each caller to the right person, department or location automatically — by time of day, caller, or menu choice — and transfer live calls in one click.

tree.aria-label: Noxtill call routing rules: incoming calls checked against business hours and the CRM, then routed to the account owner, a ring group or voicemail

tree: Call routing software decides where each call goes using simple rules: business hours, who is calling, or the option they chose. During a call, your team can transfer it to a colleague with or without an introduction.
Callers wait on hold or get bounced between people who can’t help.
Each call reaches the right person first, with context attached.
Call transfer and routing keeps wait times short.
As intelligent call routing software, Noxtill routes each call based on your business rules and real-time availability.
Create custom rules to route calls to the right person or department.
